description: This file defines two asynchronous functions, getUserCosts and getUserProjectsCosts, which perform complex aggregation queries on a MongoDB collection related to user costs. It normalizes and summarizes cost data by user, agent, type, and project, and exports these functions for use in other parts of the application.

methods.name: getUserCosts
methods.description: Aggregates total cost for a user with breakdowns by agent and type, normalizing various alias fields and handling nulls.

methods.name: getUserProjectsCosts
methods.description: Aggregates costs for a user grouped by project, including agent subtotals.
